rationale.campaign_length: 连续65个直接任务，叙事和征服范围延伸到游戏后期。
rationale.colonization: 没有以海外殖民为核心的已确认玩法循环。
rationale.complexity: 同时管理天命、族群、奴隶、工程、五军团、属国和长任务条件。
rationale.dark_story: 奴隶制、强制同化、帝国征服与神权专制是制度和叙事主轴。
rationale.difficulty: 军队强不代表轻松；灾难准备、扩张消化和后期条件都要求熟练规划。
rationale.diplomacy: 梅达西、萨特拉皮与朝贡网络是帝国治理的核心组成，而非装饰。
rationale.early_pressure: U09开局强势但需要迅速击败邻国并按前置任务塑造形成条件。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 埃利赫特、巨灵遗物、霍鲁特普神化与不死统治者是后半战役核心。
rationale.narrative_density: 格丽扎卡、帝国转型、灾难和霍鲁特普神化形成完整连续故事。
rationale.tall_play: 奴隶工程提供建设内容，但资源和任务都要求持续向外扩张。
rationale.trade_economy: 奴隶贸易、港口、工程和战争财政相互连接，但经济主要服务帝国扩张。
rationale.warfare: 征服、沿海劫掠、军团和跨洲扩张贯穿整条任务线。

identity.appearance: 以格诺拉迦兹U09完成前置任务后形成是最完整且官方设定中的路线；其他符合条件的豺狼人也可在取得哀伤河管家权威与关键领土后通过决议形成

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text: 起初，被称为赫特的神性生物与哥诺勒哈特普的豺狼人之间的关系是实用性的，赫特让豺狼人皇帝保持权力，而豺狼人则让赫特享受惯常的宠爱。随着时间的推移，豺狼人开始在赫特身上看到他们理想的体现，这些生物生活在绝对的奢华中，从不动一根手指头，并被当作神来崇拜。豺狼人贵族们开始越来越多地模仿赫特，他们建造了宏伟的游艇，乘坐它们航行在哀伤河上，并饲养了大量的仆人和奴隶，以满足他们的一切要求。豺狼人以自己的方式成为了赫特有史以来最伟大的拥护者。
description.text_en: At first the relationship between the divine beings known as the Khet, and the gnolls of Konolkhatep was one of practicality, the Khet allowing the gnollish Emperors to maintain power and the gnolls facilitating the usual level of pampering the Khet were accustomed to. Over time the gnolls began to see in the Khet the expression of their ideals, these creatures lived in absolute luxury, never lifting a finger and being worshipped as gods. The gnollish nobility began to increasingly imitate the Khet themselves, constructing grand pleasure barges on which they sailed The Sorrow and maintaining vast coteries of servants and slaves to fulfil their every whim. In their own way, the gnolls became the greatest advocates the Khet had ever known.

description.text: 长期以来，赫特拉塔的人类居民一直在为赫特信仰的多种解释而争论不休，而哥诺勒哈特普的豺狼人们却不太在意教义上的分歧，而是专注于对赫特本身的崇敬和效仿。尽管几个世纪以来他们可能会灵活地效忠于一个或另一个教派，但皇室官方对所有将赫特视为神圣的人都采取宽容政策，并采用了豺狼人风格的「哀伤河守护者」这一称号来标志他们对整个赫特教的虔诚。
description.text_en: While the human inhabitants of Kheterata had long argued and warred over the many interpretations of their Khetist faith the gnolls of Konolkhatep were less concerned with doctrinal differences and focused on the veneration and emulation of the Khet themselves. Though they might profess flexible loyalties to one sect or another over the centuries, the imperial household had an official policy of tolerance for all those who held the Khet to be sacred, adopting the gnollish style epithet of Guardian-of-The-Sorrow to mark their devotion to Khetism as a whole.

description.text: 就像阳洲中部的众多小河汇入强大的哀伤河一样，众多小国的贡品也流向强大的哥诺勒哈特普。哥诺勒哈特普的皇帝们通过劫持朝贡国统治者的长子作为人质，确保了贡品的源源不断，同时也为邻国未来的统治者继续保持这种有利可图的关系做好了准备。如果朝贡国不遵守约定，人质就会被哥诺勒哈特普王室以祭祀的方式吃掉，啃得只剩骨头的人质会被送回他们的父母身边，以警告他们不服从命令的代价。
description.text_en: Just as the many minor rivers of central Sarhal flow into the mighty Sorrow, so goes the flow of tribute from the many lesser nations into mighty Konolkhatep. By taking hostage the firstborn children of the rulers of tributary states, the Emperors of Konolkhatep were able to ensure the flow of tribute remained consistent, whilst also preparing the neighbouring rulers of the future to continue this profitable relationship. Should the tributary states not uphold their side of the bargain, then the hostages would be ritually devoured by the Konolkhatepan royal family, their gnawed bones sent back to their parents as a warning of the price of disobedience.

effects.label_zh: 属国发展度带来的独立倾向

description.text: 豺狼人统治者成为哀伤河管家之初，曾试图保留许多古老的赫特拉塔传统，以安抚他们的人类臣民。其中就包括阿哈提，他们是商人战士，是赫特拉塔人的战士种姓。虽然阿哈提传统上是一个人类机构，但随着豺狼人人口在整个赫特拉塔的不断增长，他们很快就开始建立自己的兄弟会。这些传统的阿哈提人和新的豺狼人群体之间的竞争将引发一个商人战士重新好战的时代，他们相互竞争，以获得利润丰厚的贸易合同、土地权和皇室的青睐。
description.text_en: When the gnollish rulers first became Chosen of the Khet, they attempted to maintain many of the ancient traditions of Kheterata to appease their human subjects. Among these were the Ahati, the merchant-warriors that served as the warrior caste of the Kheteratan people. While the Ahati were traditionally a human institution, the growing population of gnolls throughout Kheterata soon began establishing their own brotherhoods. The rivalries between these traditional Ahati and the new Gnollish groups would spark an era of renewed militancy among the merchant warriors as they competed against one another for lucrative trading contracts, land rights and the favour of the imperial house.

description.text: 如果说哀伤河是阳洲的命脉，那么赫特拉塔无疑就是它的心脏。随着哥诺勒哈特普占领了更多曾经属于古代帝国的土地，他们不得不与来自不同文化和生活方式的民族进行斗争。为了让这些不同民族和平共处，皇帝们颁布了一项官方宽容法令。无论你说什么语言，也无论你是什么物种，这些都不会妨碍你在哥诺勒哈特普的发展。唯一重要的是对皇帝的忠诚，当然还有对赫特的忠诚。
description.text_en: If the Sorrow is the lifeblood of Sarhal then Kheterata is undeniably it's heart. As Konolkhatep claimed more of the lands that had once belonged to the ancient empire they were forced to contend with peoples from many different cultures and ways of life. In order to keep such a disparate patchwork of people's living peacefully, the Emperors instituted an official edict of tolerance. It did not matter what language you spoke or what species you were, none of these would prevent your advancement within Konolkhatep. The only thing that mattered was loyalty to the Emperor and of course, the Khet.

description.text: 在整个历史长河中，赫特拉塔都不得不与来自境外的豺狼人袭击者作斗争。随着哥诺勒哈特普王朝的建立，这种情况终结了，豺狼人王朝征服了沙漠中的群山，为赫特拉塔带来了前所未有的和平与稳定。旅行者可以从北山前往科罗舍什港口，而不必担心突袭者，因为他们经常看到豺狼人阿哈提在帝国的公路和水道上巡逻。商人们开始将他们的深红色旗帜视为安全和好运的象征。这个稳定的时代促进了阳洲中部奴隶贸易的大规模增长，因为曾经捕捉和运输奴隶的豺狼人族群现在已被皇帝牢牢控制，商人们可以专注于利润而不是保护自己免受敌对族群和对手商队的袭击。
description.text_en: Throughout its history the lands of Kheterata have had to contend with gnollish raiders from outside its borders. With the establishment of Konolkhatep this came to an end, the gnollish dynasty subjugated the packs of the desert and brought an unprecedented era of peace and stability within the lands of Kheterata. A traveller could go from the mountains of Vus Mukis to the port of Koroshesh without fear of raiders, often seeing gnollish Ahati patrolling the highways and waterways of the empire. Merchants came to regard their deep red banners as a sign of safety and good fortune. This era of stability helped usher in a massive growth in the slave trade within central Sarhal as the gnoll packs that once captured and transported slaves were now firmly under the control of the Emperor, allowing merchants to focus on profit rather than protecting themselves from hostile packs and rival caravans.

name.text_en: Peace From The Mountains To The Sea

description.text:
奴隶制在赫特拉塔已经存在了几个世纪，但在豺狼人统治的年代，奴隶制急剧增加，尽管当时颁布的法律禁止奴役那些被归类为赫特拉塔公民——即任何在哀伤河及其支流沿岸出生的人。因此，许多奴隶从阳洲的其他地方来到这里。虽然大多数奴隶都进入了豺狼人贵族的大户人家，但受过教育或在数字方面有天赋的奴隶通常会被送到金链屋。

金链屋是一个帝国范围内的奴隶组织，隶属于皇帝，专门负责管理帝国广袤的领土。金链奴隶与驻扎地没有任何关系，他们的福利依赖于国家，因此他们被认为比本地官僚更不可能贪污资金，那些为国家效力的奴隶通常会得到甚至超过大多数自由公民所习惯的奢华奖励。
description.text_en:
Slavery had existed within Kheterata for centuries but the years of gnollish rulership brought a dramatic increase in the practice, though laws were issued that prohibited enslaving those classed as native Kheteratans, that being anyone born along The Sorrow and its tributaries. As a result many slaves were brought in from elsewhere in Sarhal. While most went on to the vast households of gnollish nobles, educated slaves or those that showed a talent for numbers were often sent to the House of Golden Chains.

The House of Golden Chains was an empire-wide organisation of slaves belonging to the Emperor who were employed solely to administer the vast territories of the empire. With no ties to the local areas they were stationed in and reliant on the state for their welfare, the Golden Chain slaves were thought to be less likely to embezzle funds than native bureaucrats and those that served the state well were often rewarded with a level of luxury beyond what even most free citizens were accustomed to.

description.text:
1438年，狼群主母，「豺狼帝王」格丽扎迦开始了她的崛起之路，她统一燔爪豺狼人，入侵伊尔斯马哈普，将赫特拉塔帝国一分为二，导致南部的提贾里赫特诸国独立。在西面，另一支豺狼人势力维亚哥吉也对赫特拉塔虎视眈眈，很快，维亚哥吉的军队就沿着哀伤河向赫特拉塔进军。

1442年，两个豺狼人国家在赫特拉特城外发生冲突。格丽扎迦的军事天才和巫术火魔法的运用使燔爪豺狼人取得了胜利，他们屠杀了一半以上的敌人，造成了对手决定性的溃败。虽然格丽扎迦的部队最终被赫特拉塔人的反击击退，但她对维亚哥吉的胜利仍被作为震慑战术重要性的最佳范例进行研究。
description.text_en:
In 1438 Pack Mistress Grizaka began her meteoric rise to power, unifying the Pyreclaw Gnolls and beginning an invasion of Irsmahapan that would split the Kheteratan empire in half, leading to the independence of the Tijarikheti states to the south. To the west, another gnollish power eyed Kheterata greedily, and soon the armies of Viakkoc marched to war along The Sorrow.

In 1442 the two gnollish states clashed outside of Kheterat. Even weakened by the siege of the city and outnumbered by their Seascourge foes, Grizaka’s military genius and use of shamanic fire magic saw the Pyreclaw victorious, slaughtering over half their enemies and causing a decisive rout. While Grizaka’s forces were eventually driven back by a Kheteratan counterattack, her victory over Viakkoc is still studied as a prime example of the importance of shock and awe tactics.

description.text: 夹在西边的风嗥豺狼人和东边的燔爪豺狼人之间，伊尔斯马哈普的人类已经习惯了应对豺狼人的突袭，但1438年的征服是他们几个世纪以来从未见过的。许多豺狼人都会用铁链锁住所有居民，而格丽扎迦却看到了将现有权力结构纳入新帝国的智慧。作为向她的军队提供食物、住所和资源的回报，人类被允许继续崇拜他们的神，并免去了祭品什一税。
description.text_en: Sandwiched between the Windhowlers to the west and the Pyreclaw to the east, the humans of Irsmahapan were used to dealing with gnollish raids, but the conquest of 1438 was unlike anything they had seen in centuries. Where many gnolls would have clapped the entire population in chains, Grizaka saw the wisdom of incorporating the existing power structures into her new empire. In return for supplying her forces with food, shelter and resources, the humans were allowed to continue worshipping their gods and were exempt from sacrificial tithes.

description.text: 格丽扎迦将维亚哥吉族群赶出赫特拉塔后，他们在西阳洲的帝国也随之覆灭。随着这个时代最强大的族群被击败，格丽扎迦宣布自己为豺狼人的女皇，寻求像赫特拉塔、凡高拉、凤凰帝国或遥远的卡斯塔诺这样的伟大国家一样的声望和合法性。这是一个强有力的声明，意在统一豺狼人，建立一个经得起时间考验的帝国。一个真正的帝国需要一个真正的首都，因此格丽扎迦下令建立了一座以她名字命名的宏伟城市——伊勒津格丽扎迦，这座城市横跨在哀伤河的一条主要支流之上。而在城市中心，一座名为格诺拉迦兹（豺狼人的堡垒）的雄伟堡垒拔地而起。
description.text_en: When Grizaka drove the Viakkoc pack out of Kheterata it led to the downfall of their empire in West Sarhal. With the greatest pack of the age now defeated, Grizaka declared herself Empress-of-Gnollkind, seeking to claim the prestige and legitimacy of great states like Kheterata, Fangaula, the Phoenix Empire or distant Castanor. It was a powerful statement of her intent to unify the gnollish peoples and create an empire that would stand the test of time. A true empire was in need of a true capital, and so Grizaka decreed the founding of a grand city bearing her name, Ilzin Grizaka, sitting astride a major tributary of the Sorrow. And at the city’s heart, a mighty fortress was built, called Gnollakaz - Fortress Of The Gnolls.

description.text: 自吹自擂在许多豺狼人文化中都很常见，但燔爪豺狼人却把自吹自擂当成了一种艺术。无论是士兵、商人还是牧师，对于燔爪豺狼人来说，没有什么比他们的名声更重要了。虽然燔爪豺狼人骄傲自负，但他们知道，如果因为一点小事就杀死对手，对族群来说将是灾难性的。因此，一种非暴力解决冲突的方式在燔爪豺狼人文化中出现了，这种方式被称为「Gremrabo」，即「辱骂战」。在「辱骂战」中，两个对立的豺狼人会当着观众的面编造出越来越离谱的辱骂对方的话，首先被骂得说不出话的豺狼人将被宣布为失败者。这一习俗的重要性得到了豺狼人的尊重，以至于有时赫特拉塔人在无法提供贡品的情况下，还能用辱骂战来拯救他们的城镇免遭即将到来的突袭。
description.text_en: Self-aggrandisement was common in many gnollish cultures but the Pyreclaw had made an art form of it. Whether soldier, merchant or priest, nothing was more important to a Pyreclaw gnoll than their reputation. Though prideful and egotistical, the Pyreclaw knew that allowing the killing of rivals over the smallest slights would be disastrous for the pack. As a result, a way of non-violently resolving conflicts emerged within Pyreclaw culture known as the Gremrabo, the "Insult War". The Gremrabo would see two opposing gnolls invent increasingly outlandish insults about their opponent in front of an audience, the first gnoll unable to respond to an insult being declared the loser. The importance of this practice became so respected by the gnolls, that on occasion Kheteratans were able to use Gremrabo to save their towns from an impending raid if they were unable to offer tribute.

effects.label_zh: 从侮辱得到的力量投射

description.text: 在燔爪豺狼人征服赫特拉塔中心地带以前，他们会定期乘坐全副武装的驳船沿河航行，这些驳船的船帆上绘有格诺拉迦兹的旗帜，上面绘着被鲜血染红的哀伤河。在旅途中，他们会以向所遇到的城镇勒索财物和奴隶贡品，并洗劫那些胆敢反抗他们的城镇。
description.text_en: Prior to their conquest of the Kheteratan heartlands, Pyreclaw gnolls would regularly sail down the river in heavily armed barges which were notable for their sails depicting the flag of Gnollakaz, a stylised design of The Sorrow running red with blood. These journeys would see them extorting tribute in the form of wealth and slaves from the towns they encountered, sacking those that dared to defy them.

description.text: 戈尔科拉的金矿在整个阳洲都声名狼藉，因为有大量奴隶在金矿深处丧生。对格诺拉迦兹的统治者来说，这只是很小的代价，大量的黄金为他们进军赫特拉塔提供了资金，并为他们的战士购买了高质量的装备。更多的黄金供应也使得贵金属在文化上的重要性与日俱增，尤其是在社会上层。随着燔爪豺狼人酋长们越来越多地定居下来，并融入了他们所统治的人类的权力结构中，对精致华美的黄金珠宝和其他饰品的需求也达到了疯狂的顶峰。
description.text_en: The gold mines of Golkora found infamy throughout Sarhal for the sheer number of slaves that lost their lives within the depths of the mines. For the rulers of Gnollakaz this was a small price to pay, the vast quantities of gold funding their campaigns into Kheterata and purchasing high quality equipment for their warriors. This greater availability also facilitated a growing cultural importance of the precious metal, particular among the upper echelons of society. As the chieftains of the Pyreclaw Gnolls became increasingly settled and integrated into the power structures of the humans they ruled over, demand for elaborate and ostentatious golden jewellery and other fancies grew to fevered heights.

description.text:
格丽扎迦进入了埃利赫特金字塔，试图玷污死去之神的尸体。她再未回归，但她的女儿得以平安继承了格诺拉迦兹的王位。她在位多年，起到了稳定人心的作用。然而，她死后，她的两个女儿，大女儿胡格勒得和小女儿吉兹得泽荷勒都试图继承王位。两姐妹之间的冲突被称为「魔舞」，一场恶性内战将格诺拉迦兹撕成碎片。

胡格勒得得到了哈佐布秘教萨满和拉迦兹契术士们的支持，同时还与布勒得古荷和维亚哥吉结成了松散的联盟，后者从北部海岸入侵，希望通过在内战中占据优势来破坏老对手的稳定。相比之下，吉兹得泽荷勒则得到了人类和赫特教教士的支持，并最终得到了东方的哈拉格得塞达的援助。最终，吉兹得泽荷勒取得了胜利，标志着燔爪豺狼人向赫特拉塔文化的重大转变，她宣布建立一个新的豺狼人-赫特拉塔国家，哥诺勒哈特普。如果她没能夺得王位，谁也不知道在胡格勒得和哈佐布秘教的统治下，格诺拉迦兹的命运会如何......
description.text_en:
When Grizaka entered the Pyramid of Elikhet to defile the dead gods corpse, she did not return, but had ensured that her daughter inherited the throne of Gnollakaz safely. She would reign for many years as a stabilising influence. However, upon her death her two daughters, the elder Xukret and the younger Kyztzehr, both attempted to claim the throne. The conflict between the two sisters became known as The Dance of Demons, and saw Gnollakaz ripped apart by a vicious civil war.

Xukret was supported by the Xhazobkult Shamans and the Warlocks of Rakkaz, as well as being loosely allied with Viakkoc who invaded from the northern coast, hoping to destabilise their old foe by tipping the scales in the civil war. By contrast, Kyztzehr was supported by the human population and the Khetist Clergy, as well as eventually the Haraagtsedi to the east. In the end Kyztzehr emerged victorious, marking a significant shift among the Pyreclaw Gnolls towards Kheteratan culture and the declaration of a new Gnollish-Kheteratan realm, Konolkhatep. Had she failed in her bid for the throne, who knows what the fate of Gnollakaz would have been under Xukret and the Xhazobkult…

player_overview.avoid_if: 如果你厌恶奴隶制叙事、只想和平种田、讨厌阅读事件，或容易被后期跨洲征服与条件清单耗尽耐心，不建议选择。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 前期用格丽扎卡快速征服哀伤河，形成后同步管理天命、族群整合、奴隶工程和属国；中期为灾难储备实力，后期依靠军团与神王继续跨洲征服。
player_overview.overview: 哥诺勒哈特普从格丽扎卡的豺狼人征服起步，继承赫特信仰与哀伤河管家制度，再以奴隶工程、五大军团、梅达西属国和霍鲁特普神化建立黑暗世界帝国。它兼具古老帝国美学与压迫性统治体验，回报极高，但中期灾难、跨洲扩张和后期清单同样沉重。
player_overview.recommended_for: 适合喜欢长篇剧情、强军滚雪球、属国网络、专属资源和灾难后飞升的玩家。
signature_features: 格诺拉迦兹九任务序章接入五十六任务的超长形成国战役。
收集奴隶并投入道路、金字塔、神庙与雕像等大型工程。
建立五支赫特拉塔军团，熬过最后的大火，将霍鲁特普塑造成永恒神王。
player_overview.tagline: 让豺狼人夺走赫特拉塔的王座，再把哀伤河帝国推向神王统治的世界霸权。

reasons: 从格丽扎卡到霍鲁特普拥有少见的完整统治者与国家转型弧线
奴隶资源、工程、五军团和管家体系带来多层专属玩法
大型灾难前后形成非常明显的强度与叙事转折
适合追求极长战役、强势终局和黑暗帝国代入感的玩家
warnings: 奴隶制与强制同化是核心内容，不是可以忽略的背景设定
中期灾难和低天命可能显著压缩操作空间
后期跨洲扩张、侵略扩张、停战与属国条件容易产生疲劳
离线Wiki对格丽扎卡被击退后的征服者有不同叙述；F66形成确年未证实，不能当作玩家必然结果

values.rationale: 奴隶被量化为国家资源并用于大型工程、军团和统治者神化，属于制度化人格工具化；征服范围不是主要扣分来源。
